TECHNICAL DATA-C.8

Connecting rod alignment
Large and small end bores must be square and parallel to each other inside the tolerance of ± 0,25 mm
(0.010 in) measured 127 mm (5 in) each side of the axis of the rod on a test mandrel as shown in fig. C1. With
the small end bush fitted, the tolerance of± 0,25 mm (0,010 in) is reduced to± 0,06 mm (0.0025 in).
